## About Moonfin

Moonfin is a collection of premium client apps for Jellyfin, Emby, Plex and Silo servers. We focus on refined user experiences, improved UI/UX, and platform-specific optimizations while keeping full compatibility with your server, so your media library is more accessible and enjoyable on every device. See it in action at [moonfin.io](https://moonfin.io).

## What Makes Moonfin Different

- **Modern UI**: Refined layouts, better information density, and smoother animations
- **Every major server**: Every client connects to Jellyfin, Emby, Plex and Silo
- **Watch Parties**: Watch together with chat, reactions, and voting on what to watch. Moonbase hosts them on Jellyfin, Emby, and Plex, Silo has its own, and SyncPlay is still there on Jellyfin
- **First-class Seerr**: The first native Jellyfin clients with Seerr discovery and requesting
- **A companion server**: Moonbase hosts the Moonfin web app, syncs settings across clients, and proxies Seerr, MDBList, and TMDB, as a plugin on Jellyfin and Emby and as Moonbase for Plex and Moonbase for Silo on those servers
- **Platform-optimized**: Each client is tailored for its device, from remote-first TV layouts to touch and desktop
- **Open source**: All improvements are available for the community to use and contribute to

Shared highlights across clients include a cross-server unified library, a profile-aware featured media bar, a community Theme Store, a calendar of upcoming episodes and movies from Sonarr and Radarr, plugin-backed settings sync and MDBList ratings, in-player trailer previews, subtitle downloads, Live TV & DVR, playlist management, global search, and automatic updates. Each client's repo lists its full feature set.

## Projects

| Project | What it is |
|---|---|
| **[Moonbase Plugin](https://github.com/Moonfin-Client/Plugin)** | The server side that powers the ecosystem: a plugin for Jellyfin and Emby, plus Moonbase for Plex and Moonbase for Silo from the same repo. It handles settings sync, Watch Parties, the Seerr proxy and SSO, shared MDBList/TMDB APIs, custom themes, and the hosted Moonfin web app. Strongly recommended for all users, and required for Seerr. |
| **[Moonfin Core](https://github.com/Moonfin-Client/Moonfin-Core)** ([wiki](https://github.com/Moonfin-Client/Moonfin-Core/wiki)) | The unified Flutter client for Android, iOS, macOS, Windows, Linux, and web, and the shared codebase behind the Android TV, Fire TV (Fire OS), and Apple TV apps. |
| **[Smart TV](https://github.com/Moonfin-Client/Smart-TV)** ([wiki](https://github.com/Moonfin-Client/Smart-TV/wiki)) | The Samsung (Tizen), LG (webOS), Fire TV (Vega OS), and Xbox client, built with React/Enact/Sandstone over native per-platform video pipelines. |
| **[Roku](https://github.com/Moonfin-Client/Roku)** ([wiki](https://github.com/Moonfin-Client/Roku/wiki)) | The Roku client, built in BrighterScript and forked from the official Jellyfin Roku app. |
| **[Themes](https://github.com/Moonfin-Client/Themes)** | The community theme catalog behind the in-app Theme Store. Every client reads its `index.json` at runtime, and new themes are contributed by pull request. |

For features, codec support, install steps, and build instructions, see each project's README and wiki.

## Installation & Setup

Each client has its own install method, linked in the table above:

- **Android phones, tablets, and Android TV**: [Google Play](https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=org.moonfin.androidtv) or [F-Droid](https://fdroid.link/#https://fdroid.moonfin.io/repo?fingerprint=E92F0E888A61F60272533D023BE022A570CFA4933D57235EE48732D3742EBE96), or sideload the APK from [Moonfin-Core releases](https://github.com/Moonfin-Client/Moonfin-Core/releases) (Android 7.0+)
- **Fire TV**: The [Amazon Appstore](https://www.amazon.com/Moonfin/dp/B0H76BG3DW) on both Fire OS and Vega OS sticks. Fire OS can also sideload the Android APK, and Vega OS the VPKG from [Smart-TV releases](https://github.com/Moonfin-Client/Smart-TV/releases) in Developer Mode
- **iOS / tvOS / macOS**: [App Store](https://apps.apple.com/app/moonfin/id6761283970). On macOS, Homebrew (`brew install --cask moonfin`) and the DMG from [Moonfin-Core releases](https://github.com/Moonfin-Client/Moonfin-Core/releases) work too
- **Windows**: [Microsoft Store](https://apps.microsoft.com/detail/9plb327dd51d), `winget install Moonfin.Moonfin`, or the x64 and ARM64 installers from [Moonfin-Core releases](https://github.com/Moonfin-Client/Moonfin-Core/releases)
- **Linux**: [Flathub](https://flathub.org/en/apps/io.moonfin.moonfin) (`flatpak install flathub io.moonfin.moonfin`), the AUR (`yay -S moonfin-bin`), or the AppImage, deb, rpm, snap, and tarball builds in [Moonfin-Core releases](https://github.com/Moonfin-Client/Moonfin-Core/releases)
- **Samsung (Tizen) / LG (webOS)**: Neither TV store carries Moonfin yet, so it's sideloaded from [Smart-TV releases](https://github.com/Moonfin-Client/Smart-TV/releases). On LG the [Homebrew Channel](https://repo.webosbrew.org/apps/org.moonfin.webos/) is the easy route, and on Samsung [Apps2Samsung](https://github.com/Apps2Samsung/Apps2Samsung) signs and installs the WGT for you
- **Xbox**: Install from the [Microsoft Store](https://apps.microsoft.com/detail/9plb327dd51d), or sideload the ZIP from [Smart-TV releases](https://github.com/Moonfin-Client/Smart-TV/releases) in Developer Mode ([guide](https://github.com/Moonfin-Client/Smart-TV/wiki/Installation-and-Sideloading#xbox))
- **Roku**: Install from the [Roku Channel Store](https://channelstore.roku.com/details/92a83c9f4112b76a7bcee3dc076254ca:3251a91bf7af7339652d5409ccfdcb39/moonfin), or sideload the ZIP from [releases](https://github.com/Moonfin-Client/Roku/releases) in Developer Mode
- **Web**: Install the [Moonbase Plugin](https://github.com/Moonfin-Client/Plugin) on your server, and it serves the Moonfin web app as an installable PWA at `/Moonfin/Web/`. On Plex it's on Moonbase for Plex's port, 32500, and on Silo it's under Plugin Apps

### Optional: Seerr

Install [Seerr](https://seerr.dev/) on your network, then set its URL in Moonbase's settings (your server's Dashboard > Plugins > Moonbase, or Moonbase for Plex's admin page). Moonbase proxies all Seerr traffic through your server, so clients only need to reach your server. Silo servers use Silo's own requests instead.
